root_text:
Symptoms of human metapneumovirus (#HMPV) are chills, cough, sore throat, weakness and dizziness. The virus is most dangerous for children. 
There are already infected people in China, the United Kingdom and Kazakhstan. https://t.co/H2cFhKG
